obligations.note: The changed line in ApplicantValidator.checkIncome now logs the raw `value` via log.warn, replacing the earlier Mask.npi(value). annual_income is NPI (ENC-1 statement; mortgage.npi_fields), so a malformed income value is written unmasked to the application log on this error path. The passing sample test LoggingControlTest#sampledFlowsDoNotLogNpi evidently does not cover this flow.

No exception covers this deviation. EXC-0167 is the only LOG-1 exception for mortgage.logging, and it is scoped to a legacy import job writing a masked last-4 of the bank account number, not unmasked annual income from ApplicantValidator (component mortgage.cases).

Ticket CHG-26593 is a standard ticket, approved by Erik Brandt (change_manager) at 2026-10-04T02:20Z, before the change was opened. Its component mortgage.cases covers ApplicantValidator.java, the only changed file.
The code_review approval is from declan.farrell@fernbrook.example. He holds change_approver for baseline-mortgage and is not the author, Tomas Ortega.
The approval names the head and only commit, 599a8a8e, so no later commits exist.

run.json reports success on the head commit from ci-runner-06, started 2026-10-04. The attached JUnit reports, however, are timestamped 2026-10-23 and come from host dev-laptop-7.local, so it cannot be established that they belong to this CI run on this commit.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers ApplicantValidator.java. No previously accepted evidence is lapsed by this change.

summary: The change replaces a masked log of a rejected annual income value with the raw value. Annual income is NPI, so this directly violates LOG-1. No approved, in-scope exception covers it: EXC-0167 concerns masked bank-account last-4 in a legacy import job. The ticket and approval records are in order. The CI evidence is also questionable, because the JUnit reports' timestamps and host do not match the recorded CI run. The change is rejected because of the LOG-1 violation.
